description: This Python source file defines a class SimpleTextAggregator for basic sentence boundary detection in text processing, particularly for TTS scenarios. It includes methods for aggregating text, detecting sentence boundaries with lookahead, flushing remaining text, handling interruptions, and resetting internal state.

classes.name: SimpleTextAggregator
classes.description: A class that accumulates text until sentence boundaries are detected, suitable for TTS text processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the text buffer and lookahead flag.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Property that returns the currently accumulated text as an Aggregation object.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, yielding complete sentences.

methods.name: _check_sentence_with_lookahead
methods.description: Checks for sentence boundaries using lookahead logic, calling external functions to confirm sentence end.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Returns any remaining text in the buffer as a sentence at stream end.

methods.name: handle_interruption
methods.description: Clears the internal text buffer upon interruption.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state, clearing accumulated text.
